summary: Korea Electric Power Corp filed a Form 6-K clarification responding to media reports of a Korean government plan to merge its five power generation subsidiaries into a single entity. The government announced this proposal on September 3, 2026, as part of a functional reform of public institutions. No specific terms, deal structure, or valuation details were disclosed. The registrant stated it will re-disclose matters when specific details are determined or within one month. The potential divestiture would affect KEPCO's generation assets, though regulatory and structural specifics remain entirely unspecified. Watch for further government announcements detailing merger terms, valuation, and potential regulatory approvals.
